tools.name: find_skill_by_capability
tools.title: Find skill by capability tag
tools.description: Find skills in the org registry that provide a given capability tag (dotted lowercase, e.g. 'invoice.extract' or 'po.match'). Returns a list of skill summaries; each summary includes the MCP binding the agent needs to call the underlying skill server. By default only returns published skills.

published_only.description: If true (default), only return skills whose lifecycle stage is 'published'.

tools.name: describe_skill
tools.title: Describe a skill in full
tools.description: Return the full manifest for a skill, including governance (RBAC, data classification), scoring (determinism, risk), preconditions, effects, and a 'payloadFiles' list of skill:// resource URIs (SKILL.md narrative, asset schemas, scripts). Read those resources on demand — they don't count against the agent context budget. Call this after find_skill_by_capability when you need to decide whether a skill is safe to use for the task at hand.

tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.title: List all capabilities in the org
tools.description: List every capability tag in the registry mapped to the skills that provide it. Use this for catalog discovery when you do not yet have a specific task in mind, or when you need to confirm a tag exists before calling find_skill_by_capability.

tools.name: submit_skill_draft
tools.title: Submit a new skill draft (opens a PR)
tools.description: Propose a new skill by opening a GitHub PR against the registry. Pass a manifest object that conforms to schemas/skill-manifest.schema.json plus an optional payload mapping (e.g. {'SKILL.md': '...', 'assets/output-schema.json': '...'}). Returns {pr_url, pr_number, branch, files_added}. The PR review is the Register gate — a human approver must merge before the skill becomes discoverable. Use this when an agent or human author wants to share a skill they built.

manifest.description: Skill manifest object. Must validate against schemas/skill-manifest.schema.json.

payload.description: Optional map of relative file path to UTF-8 text content (SKILL.md, assets/, scripts/). Paths must not contain '..' or start with '/'.

title.description: Optional PR title. Defaults to 'Register skill: <skill_id>'.

body.description: Optional PR body / motivation. Defaults to a templated summary.
